 import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

data = {
    'Year': [2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023],
    'North America': [45.2, 48.7, 52.3, 56.1, 62.4],
    'Europe': [51.8, 54.2, 58.9, 61.5, 64.3],
    'Asia-Pacific': [38.7, 42.5, 46.8, 51.2, 55.6],
    'Latin America': [18.3, 20.6, 23.1, 25.7, 28.4],
    'Middle East & Africa': [24.5, 26.9, 29.8, 33.2, 36.7]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df.set_index('Year', inplace=True)

colors = ['#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e', '#2ca02c', '#d62728', '#9467bd']

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 7))

ax.stackplot(df.index,
             df['North America'],
             df['Europe'],
             df['Asia-Pacific'],
             df['Latin America'],
             df['Middle East & Africa'],
             labels=['Europe', 'North America', 'Asia-Pacific', 'Latin America', 'Middle East & Africa'],
             colors=colors,
             alpha=0.8)

ax.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Broadband Infrastructure Investment (Billion USD)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_title('Global Mobile Network Coverage by Region (2019-2023)',
             fontsize=16, pad=20)
ax.legend(loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(1, 1), fontsize=10)
ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
ax.margins(0, 0.05)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.gca().set_ylim(0, 202.6)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
